tags.title: Are detection residuals explained by quarantined (corrupted) events?
tags.concept: Residual analysis: anti-joins, regexp_extract on raw dead-letter payloads, equi-join to explain each residual
tags.question: For labelled runs that lack the expected finding, and for findings on runs without labels, was one of the run's own events quarantined by the stream processor?
tags.interpretation: Volume benchmarks inject ~0.1% corrupt records on purpose (and the truncation test 25%). A quarantined security.finding event looks like a missed detection; a quarantined run.metrics event drops the run's labels so its findings look unlabelled. Residuals with explained_by_quarantine = residual_runs are data-quality effects, not detector errors; unexplained residuals would need investigation.
